critic_scores.rationale: The response contains a critical factual error: yes/no questions in Swedish (ja/nej-frågor) are formed by inverting the subject and verb (subject-verb inversion), not by adding 'nej' at the end of a sentence. Adding 'nej' at the end of a sentence is not a grammatical rule in Swedish at all. The previously flagged issue FC-001 regarding incorrect use of 'så' instead of 'ja' has not been addressed, and a new, equally serious error has been introduced.
critic_scores.improvement_tip: Correct the explanation to state that Swedish yes/no questions are formed through subject-verb inversion — the finite verb is placed before the subject (e.g., 'Du talar svenska.' becomes 'Talar du svenska?') — which is the standard rule in Swedish grammar.
